title: Overview's late-income card reads 'the job pay pay has not arrived yet'
detail: Dense account with an income rule named 'Job pay' (every 2 weeks) whose 14 Nov occurrence is unconfirmed. #/money (any size) shows the card 'Income · on Fri 27 Nov — the job pay pay has not arrived yet'. The sub-line appends ' pay' to the lower-cased rule name, so any rule whose name already ends in 'pay' (Job pay, Pay, Holiday pay) doubles it, and a rule named 'Student Finance' reads 'the student finance pay' (a grant is not pay). Reproduced twice (mac, after reload).
rootCause: js/modules/money.js:410 — head(..., "the " + o.name.toLowerCase() + " pay has not arrived yet") hard-codes the word 'pay' after the user's own rule name.
fix: Use the rule's name as written: '<Name> has not arrived yet' (as the notice at js/core/money.js:1835 already does).

title: Pots: a non-lead pot's ⋯ › Make this a goal makes a new goal every time and the card never shows the goal it has
detail: #/money/pots with two pots (Laptop leads, Emergency below). Emergency ⋯ › Make this a goal › Save goal, then again: state.goals.items holds two 'Save for Emergency' money-save goals linked to the same pot (ids 11 and 12). The Emergency card shows no goal pill and keeps offering 'Make this a goal'; only the lead pot (potHero) looks for an existing goal and swaps the button for the pill. The preset also invents a £100 target for a pot with no target (Emergency has none) without saying so. Reproduced twice.
rootCause: js/modules/money.js:1602 — potCard's menu always lists 'Make this a goal' and the card body never reads KOS.goals; only potHero (js/modules/money.js:1518, 1536-1539) checks g.links.pot. openPotGoal (js/modules/money.js:1588-1594) passes target: p.target ? p.target/100 : 100.
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/money-goals/pot-emergency-twogoals-mac-dense.png; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/money-goals/pot-emergency-goal-dialog-mac-dense.png; eval goals: ['10 Save for Laptop','11 Save for Emergency','12 Save for Emergency']
fix: In potCard, look up the pot's money-save goal as potHero does: show the 標 pill (open the goal) and replace the menu item with 'Open goal'; leave the target empty when the pot has none so the reader types it.

title: Goal dialog from a pot: the money line reads 'one about every 1 days' / '4.8 a day' with no currency
detail: Pots › Make this a goal (bk:goals#2), deadline 31 Mar 2027: a £600 target shows 'The line: 4.8 a day.'; a £100 target (the default for a pot with no target) shows 'The line: one about every 1 days.'; £20 shows 'one about every 6 days'. For money the line should be an amount per day/week (£4.84 a day, £0.80 a day). Reproduced twice.
rootCause: js/modules/goals.js:1024 — line() formats every target as a count ('N a day' or 'one about every N days'), ignoring the money flag the same function uses at :1015.
fix: When money, print U.amount-formatted per-day (or per-week when under £1 a day) figure; never the 'one about every' form.

title: Recurring › Confirm all writes a second entry for an occurrence the statement already holds (it only warns)
detail: Dense account, midata-autumn.csv imported (73 rows), then a Netflix rule made from Done's 'Make it recurring' (start 12 Nov). Recurring's 'Not yet confirmed' lists Netflix 12 Nov with 'Matches statement · Netflix · 12 Nov — Use statement entry'. Confirm all › Confirm all: the 12 Nov day now holds r:<rule>:2026-11-12 (src rule, £5.99) AND the imported t-… (src csv, £5.99) — £5.99 counted twice in Out, Subscriptions and safe-to-spend. The dialog body says '1 matches an imported statement entry — link it individually if you do not want a second entry', but the bulk action already knows the single candidate. Also matchedCount is filled by async bankMatches callbacks, so a Confirm all pressed before they land says nothing. Reproduced twice (Undo restores 191→179 entries correctly).
rootCause: js/modules/money.js:1244-1260 (confirmAll) calls M.confirm for every item; the per-row bankMatches result (js/modules/money.js:1301-1315) is only drawn as a button and never used by confirmAll. Invariant 5a: Confirm OFFERS a stored bank entry instead of making a second one.
fix: In confirmAll, run bankMatches per item and use M.confirmWith for an item with exactly one candidate (as 'Use statement entry' does), counting those as linked in the dialog; only items with no statement entry get M.confirm.

title: Import preview: a row that pays a recurring rule shows 'Other income', counts as 'to categorise', and the category you pick is thrown away
detail: Preview of midata-autumn.csv: 6 'Acme Cafe Ltd Wages' rows matched to the Job pay rule (teal '↻ Job pay' chip) show the picker on 'Other income' in its amber 'choose' state and make up all 6 of the '6 to categorise' count; the 'To categorise' filter lists only them. On import they are stored under the rule's category (Job), and Done says nothing is left to categorise. Choosing 'Allowance' on the 14 Nov row before importing is ignored: the stored entry is r:<rule>:2026-11-14 with cat 'job'. So the preview shows a category that will not be stored, asks for work that is not needed, and offers a choice that has no effect. Reproduced twice (two previews; the override run once).
rootCause: js/core/money.js:1387-1422 matchRules sets x.match but leaves x.cat/x.catFrom from the merchant table; js/core/money.js:1512 importRows then overwrites f.cat = r.cat for a matched row; js/modules/moneyimp.js:208-215 counts() and :292-305 catControl treat catFrom 'default' as to-categorise regardless of x.match.
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/money-goals/import-preview-tocategorise-mac-dense.png; eval stored ['r:r-vqtz6fs2tyai:2026-11-14|job|Job pay'] after picking Allowance
fix: When matchRules links a row, set x.cat = r.cat and x.catFrom = 'rule' (shown as 'the rule'); either disable the picker on a matched row or honour a choice the reader made (f.cat = x.catFrom === 'you' ? x.cat : r.cat).

title: The new Imports page (#/money/imports) has no way in, and does not show the counts the QoL item asked for
detail: bk:money-goals#4 added the route #/money/imports (title Imports, its own Import… action). No control in the app navigates to it: Money's section tabs do not list it, the settings gear does not, Transactions still has its own Entries/Imports switch, and search has no Money results; it is reachable only by typing the address. On it no section tab is selected. Each row shows the file, range, rows and date, but not the duplicates skipped or rows that could not be read that docs/qol/PLAN.md:487 lists, because the import record stores only n. Checked twice.
rootCause: js/modules/money.js:151 and :1828-1834 add the view; grep finds no go('imports') or link to it in js/; js/core/money.js:1532-1535 importRows records n only (no skipped/bad).
fix: Point Transactions' 'Imports' switch (and Done's footer) at #/money/imports, or drop the route; record skipped and unreadable counts on the import record and print them on the row.

title: A typed entry that took a statement's identity is not recognised by the same month's other export: OFX/QIF import the payment again
detail: Dense account. A typed entry 'Heron Foods' £3.45 on 28 Oct. Import midata-autumn.csv: its HERON FOODS 29/10 £3.45 row is skipped as 'Same as Heron Foods · 28 Oct' and the typed entry adopts the row's identity (money-goals#2) — correct. Then import Santander's OFX (or QIF) of the same October (tools/fixtures/money/santander.ofx): the preview lists '29 Oct · Heron Foods · −£3.45' as NEW, and importing stores a second £3.45 Heron Foods entry (t-xqkfzz1a5pxj, src csv) beside the typed one. The same payment through another export is supposed to be known by day, amount, direction and merchant (dupOf 'similar'), and it is for rows that came in as imports — but not for one a typed entry adopted. Reproduced with OFX twice (import, undo, preview again) and with QIF.
rootCause: js/core/money.js:1329 builds the 'similar' index only from t.src === 'csv' rows, and an adopting entry keeps src 'manual' and its own typed date (28 Oct, not the bank's 29 Oct); js/core/money.js:1430-1432 matchTyped then skips it because it now has t.imp. So once adopted, the entry is invisible to both checks.
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/money-goals/import-preview-ofx-after-adopt-mac-dense.png; /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/money-goals/import-preview-qif-after-adopt-mac-dense.png; eval range 26–30 Oct: 't-wupfy1octyaz | manual | 345 | Heron Foods' and 't-xqkfzz1a5pxj | csv | 345 | Heron Foods | b-wdzmasea5pxj'
fix: Index an adopting entry (t.adopt or t.imp with src manual/rule) in alike under the BANK's date and merchant taken from t.imp/t.bank (keep the bank's date on the identity when adopting), so a second export of the same payment is 'similar'; cover it in smoke149/161.

title: Overview › By week: bar heights do not follow the printed amounts (£147 and £244 draw 66px and 70px) and past bars are darker than the card
detail: Dense account after the autumn import, #/money at mac and iphone. By week prints £243.87, £147.25, £198.31, £152.35, £71.81; --h is 100%, 60%, 81%, 62%, 29% but the measured bars are 70, 66, 70, 68 and 32 px — the first four look the same height. The past bars are filled with --s3 (oklch 0.14) on a card of oklch 0.20, so they read as holes, not bars. Measured twice (mac, iphone; identical).
rootCause: css/views/money.css:490-491 — .k-mn-wk is a flex column 100% high holding the value, the bar (block-size: var(--h), a % of the whole column) and the label; the three together overflow and flex-shrink squeezes every bar towards the same height. The bar colour is var(--s3), below the card surface.
fix: Give the bar its own track (a flex:1 1 0; min-block-size:0 wrapper) and set the bar's height as a % of that track with flex-shrink:0; colour past weeks with a chart token above the surface (as By merchant's bars do).

title: Overview chip says 'Pay due Fri 27 Nov · in 0 days' on the day itself
detail: #/money on 27 Nov with Student Finance expected today (after the Job pay was received): the hero chip reads '◷ Pay due Fri 27 Nov · in 0 days'. Should read 'Pay due today'. Seen twice (iphone, mac).
rootCause: js/modules/money.js:267 — ' · in ' + between(now, nextPay.date) + ' days' with no case for 0.

title: Transactions bulk 'Set category' still files income under a spending category (MG-28 not fixed)
detail: Tick one income entry (Gran +£30, Gifts received) › Set category: the menu lists only spending categories; choosing Social stores {kind:'in', cat:'social'}. With Select all over November, the Job pay income (a confirmed rule occurrence) was filed under Food: summary('2026-11').byCat.food = {out: £602.29, income: £120}, so Food's row and 'over budget' figures mix income in. Reproduced twice. There is no Undo for the bulk change either.
rootCause: js/modules/money.js (drawBulk → bulkSet) excludes only wishlist and transfer rows; it applies an 'out' category to kind 'in' rows. No W4 commit touched it (git log 4c3fc33..0c93408a).
evidence: /Users/fj/Developer/KurenaiOS-519/audit-evidence/2026-12/shots/money-goals/tx-bulk-cat-income-mac-dense.png; eval Gran after: ['in|social']; summary food income 12000
fix: As November said: offer In categories for income rows (or skip and name rows whose kind does not fit), and give the bulk change an Undo toast.
phase1: bk:money-goals#4 Select all (4a1d07d2) makes it one click for the whole month

title: New entry: switching Out to In still saves the Out category while the picker shows Job (MG-32 not fixed)
detail: Transactions › ＋ Add entry › In › amount 12.34 › Save: the Category picker shows 'Job' (value job) but the stored entry is {kind:'in', cat:'food'}. Food then carries £12.34 of income. Reproduced twice (both test entries deleted after).
rootCause: js/modules/money.js:855-856 the kind switch (seg … function (k) { kind = k; draw(); }) redraws the select from the In categories but leaves lines[i].cat at the Out default 'food' (line 846); the select's value falls back to its first option while the model keeps 'food'.
fix: On a kind switch, reset each line's cat to the new kind's default when it is not one of that kind's categories (November's fix).

title: Import reads '(3.45)' and '3.45 DR' as money in, and '=1+1' as £11.00 (MG-26 not fixed)
detail: A CSV with Date,Description,Amount rows '(3.45)', '3.45 DR' and '=1+1': the preview shows +£3.45, +£3.45 and +£11.00, all as income (Other income), so importing turns two payments out into money in and invents £11. Reproduced twice (mac, iphone previews).
rootCause: js/core/moneyimport.js:68-75 amount() strips every character but digits, '.', ',', '-' — brackets, DR/CR and operators are dropped, and the sign is lost.
fix: Treat '(n)' and a trailing DR as negative and CR as positive; refuse a cell with any other non-number character (report the row as unreadable instead of guessing).

title: Editing a pot move into a between-pots move still keeps the original and adds two (MG-27 not fixed)
detail: Edit the 2 Sep '£40 into Emergency' move, set From to Laptop (To stays Emergency), Save: the list now holds the original Emergency +£40 plus a new Laptop −£40 and a second Emergency +£40 — Emergency shows £40 too much and Laptop goes to −£40. Reproduced (and November's evidence is the same code path); the test entries were removed.
rootCause: js/modules/money.js:924-930 — the between-pots branch calls M.addTx twice and returns before the 'existing' updateTx at :940, so an edit never touches the entry being edited.
fix: When editing, update the existing entry into one half (updateTx) and add only the other (November's fix).

title: Budgets › Payday picker still does nothing while the month starts on the 1st (MG-31 not fixed)
detail: #/money/budgets with 'The 1st' on: choose 15th in 'Payday is the' — the select shows 15th but monthStart stays 1; pressing 'Payday · the 28th' then starts the month on the 28th, not the 15th you chose. Reproduced twice.
rootCause: js/modules/money.js:1090 — dayPick's change handler only applies when M.data().monthStart !== 1; the seg's label and value use the fixed payday 28 (:1086).
fix: Picking a day switches to Payday on that day (November's fix).

title: November P3s marked fixed by W4 are still open: search by category or amount (MG-35), reopen a closed pot (MG-36), record a price rise (MG-42), CSV formula cells (MG-44)
detail: MG-35: Transactions search 'Transport', 'Gifts' and '20.20' each find nothing although November holds Transport entries and a £20.20 Costa. MG-36: grep finds no Reopen for a closed pot. MG-42: setPrice still has no caller in js/modules. MG-44: an entry whose payee is =HYPERLINK("http://x") exports as '"=HYPERLINK(""http://x"")"' — quoted but not neutralised, so a spreadsheet still runs it. None of these appears in any W4 commit message (39c1794f, e0070e2f list MG-02..08, 10, 24, 25 only). Each checked twice.
rootCause: js/core/money.js listFilter (search haystack payee+note+tags+bank text only); js/core/money.js csvCell (quotes only on , " newline ;); no Reopen in js/modules/money.js closePot; setPrice exported but unused.
evidence: eval search results 0/0/0; eval export line '2026-11-20,out,1.00,Other,"=HYPERLINK(...)",...'; grep -n 'setPrice(' js/modules → none
fix: November's fixes: add category name and amount to the search haystack; a Closed pots list with Reopen; ask 'From when?' and call setPrice on an amount change with history; prefix a cell starting with = + - @ with an apostrophe.
